statements.quote: NEW YORK, July 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) – IREN Limited (NASDAQ: IREN) (“IREN”) today announced that it has raised its year-end AI Cloud annualized run-rate revenue (“ARR”) 1 target from $3.7bn to more than $4bn 2 , of which approximately 85% is now under contract following new multi-year cloud services contracts with leading AI developers representing $2.8bn in total contract value .
statements.notes: The figure is 'more than $4bn', recorded as a $4bn floor. It is an annualized run-rate (ARR) target at a point in time, not revenue recognized for a fiscal year. The sentence says 'year-end' without naming a year. p03 places it at calendar year-end 2026, which falls in IREN's fiscal 2027 because its fiscal year ends June 30, so fiscal_year is left null. The 85% is the share of that ARR under contract, not AI's share of revenue. The $2.8bn is total contract value across multiple years, so neither is recorded.
